queue.title: Task queue
queue.description: The main section. Drop in VOD or stream links — Fetchr downloads, trims and processes them. Supports Twitch, Kick, YouTube and direct M3U8 links.

queue_add.title: Add a task
queue_add.description: Opens the add dialog. Paste a link, pick quality, a time range and a processing preset. Several ranges can be queued at once.
queue_add.tip: Presets store a whole settings bundle for reuse

queue_run.title: Start the queue
queue_run.description: Runs every task in the queue. Concurrency is configured in Settings → General. You can pause while it runs.

queue_filters.title: Task filters
queue_filters.description: Filter by status: All, Active, Queued, Completed, Errors. The Errors tab shows each task with the reason it failed.

queue_clear.title: Clear completed
queue_clear.description: Removes finished tasks from the list. Files are untouched — they are already saved in your working folder.

live_recorder.title: Stream recording
live_recorder.description: Auto-records live broadcasts. Add a channel and Fetchr watches it, starting the recording the moment the streamer goes live. Multiple channels at once.

finder.title: M3U8 Finder
finder.description: Recovers deleted or sub-only Twitch VODs through public trackers. Enter the streamer's name and a date — Fetchr checks lossless.tv, Sullygnome and others.
finder.tip: Found links can be sent straight to the queue

chat_render.title: Chat render
chat_render.description: Downloads Twitch/Kick chat and renders it to video with a transparent background — ideal for overlaying on the recording. Fonts, position, BetterTTV / FFZ / 7TV.
chat_render.tip: Export to MOV with alpha for compositing in your editor

sponsor_blur.title: Sponsor blur
sponsor_blur.description: Blurs logos and sponsor zones. Upload a reference frame, mark the area — Fetchr applies the blur across the whole video automatically.

fetchr_mute.title: Profanity mute
fetchr_mute.description: Finds and mutes profanity in the audio automatically. Runs locally, no internet needed. Handy for YouTube clips.

vocal_remover.title: Vocal Remover
vocal_remover.description: Splits audio into vocals and instrumental using the Demucs / MDX neural nets. Get a clean backing track or isolated vocals from any video.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Every error, warning and app event. If a task failed, look here for details. Filter by level and source.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Working folder, concurrency, proxy, ffmpeg/yt-dlp paths, GPU encoding, Twitch/Kick integrations, license. Help & FAQ live here too.

components.tracker: Tracker neural net for sponsor blur

tools.queue: Download VODs, clips and streams from Twitch, YouTube, Kick and more. A queue with priorities and parallel downloads.
tools.live_recorder: Watches channels and starts recording when the streamer goes live. Several broadcasts at once.
tools.finder: Finds M3U8 links of deleted and hidden Twitch VODs by channel and date via public trackers.
tools.chat_render: Downloads the stream chat and burns it into the video: emotes, badges, your layout and style.
tools.sponsor_blur: Blurs sponsor logos in video. A neural tracker keeps the blur on a moving logo.
tools.fetchr_mute: Recognises speech and mutes swearing in video. Works offline — the model downloads once.
tools.vocal_remover: Splits voice from music: removes background music from a stream or extracts clean vocals.

simple.recovered_many: Deleted recordings: {{count}}. I'll find a live link myself, up to a minute per recording.

errors.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp not found. Install the components in settings.
errors.subscriber_only: This recording is for channel subscribers only. Add the Twitch auth-token of a subscribed account in integration settings.
errors.private_video: The video is private: the author shared it only with selected people.
errors.members_only: The video is for channel members only.
errors.age_restricted: The video is age-restricted. Sign in to YouTube in your browser so Fetchr can use its cookies.
errors.bot_check: YouTube asks to confirm you're not a bot. Sign in to YouTube in your browser and try again.
errors.geo_blocked: The video isn't available in your region. Turn on a proxy in settings.
errors.proxy_failed: The proxy isn't responding. Check the proxy address in settings or turn it off.
errors.offline: The channel isn't live right now.
errors.unavailable: The video is unavailable: it was deleted or hidden.
errors.not_found: Nothing at this link (error 404). Make sure the whole link was copied.
errors.forbidden: The server denied access (error 403). Try a proxy or update yt-dlp.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a couple of minutes and try again.
errors.unsupported_url: This link isn't supported. Paste a link to a channel, recording, clip or video.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet or proxy.
